name: callouts
title: Callouts
description: Make important text stand out in issue descriptions and knowledge base articles with Note, Tip, Important, Warning and Caution panels. Write them as GitHub-style alerts — "> [!WARNING]" followed by quoted lines — and they are turned into panels when the text is saved, or insert one from the editor toolbar instead. Types, titles, colours and icons are configurable per project.
